scene: Morning after a raid: partially scorched English wooden quay, overturned empty barrels, a damaged mooring post, thin smoke fading over water; three townspeople quietly recover sacks and inspect damage. Buildings largely still standing. No corpses or blood, no apocalyptic destruction.
prompt:
Create ONE complete illustration for a historical city-building game, one continuous scene, NOT a contact sheet, no collage, no inset panels. Reference 1 sets the muted hand-painted naturalistic storybook landscape style; reference 2 contains multiple examples ONLY for brushwork and materials (do not copy its multi-panel layout); reference 3 sets grounded painted human face style. Southern England in 1318–1347, ordinary timber/plaster/thatch medieval buildings with NO household chimneys, muted ochres, dusty reds and grey greens, subtle painted texture, soft natural light, modest human scale, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, interface, border or watermark. No horror, no gore. Landscape format 960:540, fill complete image edge to edge. Morning after a raid: partially scorched English wooden quay, overturned empty barrels, a damaged mooring post, thin smoke fading over water; three townspeople quietly recover sacks and inspect damage. Buildings largely still standing. No corpses or blood, no apocalyptic destruction. Output 960 by 540 pixels.
ROOF CORRECTION: TARGETED LOCAL EDIT of this exact illustration. Preserve all composition, people, faces, poses, buildings, objects, lighting and brushwork. ONLY REMOVE EVERY domestic rooftop chimney, chimney pot, masonry stack or flue, including small distant ones. Specifically remove masonry chimney with two red pots behind near thatched roof at x181..197,y59..91 in 960x540 image. Reconstruct continuous roof tile/thatch/ridge and correct background behind removed stacks. No physical chimney shafts anywhere on houses. Do not just remove smoke. Preserve church towers, wall towers and ordinary gable peaks. No added objects, no changes to heraldry. Same exact image and aspect ratio.
postprocess: Lanczos3 resize and central cover crop to target; opaque illustration PNG
